name: BU Labels 2025 Hoodie
description: BUnique Collection Labels Hoodie. Premium cotton-blend fabric with clean typography styling, ribbed cuffs, and front kangaroo pockets.

preOrderInfo.paymentPolicy: Payment is required when placing your pre-order to guarantee your production slot.

details.material: Heavyweight 330 GSM brushed cotton-poly blend (80% combed cotton, 20% polyester). Premium inner fleece provides optimal warmth without excessive bulk.
details.sizeFit: Collegiate relaxed streetwear fit. Dropped shoulder seams with reinforced double-needle stitching. Fits true to size; order one size up for an oversized streetwear look.
details.care: Machine wash cold inside out with like colors. Do not bleach. Tumble dry low or line dry in shade. Cool iron on reverse side; avoid ironing directly on graphic prints.
details.shippingReturns: Store Pickup: Free pickup at BU Student Center, Ground Floor (Mon–Fri, 9:00 AM – 4:00 PM). Courier Delivery: 2–3 business days within Albay; 4–7 business days nationwide. Returns: 7-day hassle-free replacement for defective items or size adjustments.

reviews.author: Eleanor S.
reviews.comment: The double-brushed inner fleece is incredibly soft! Wore it to campus during rainy days and it kept me warm all day. The typography embroidery is immaculate.

reviews.author: Carlos M.
reviews.comment: Fits true to size with a nice structured boxy silhouette. The hood has great structure and doesn't flop over. Definitely worth the pre-order wait!

reviews.author: Samantha B.
reviews.comment: Thick premium fabric and clean seams. Sleeves are just the right length. Just wash it inside out so the lettering stays pristine.

name: Bicol University Hoodie
description: Classic Bicol University Hoodie with collegiate varsity lettering across the chest. Built with double-brushed inner fleece for maximum comfort.

details.material: 320 GSM Premium Fleece (75% Cotton, 25% Polyester). Pre-shrunk fabric to minimize shrinkage after washing.
details.sizeFit: Standard unisex collegiate cut with relaxed room in the chest and arms. Rib-knit cuffs and waist hem provide snug retention.
details.care: Machine wash cold with gentle detergent. Avoid chlorine bleach. Hang dry or tumble dry low. Do not iron silkscreen graphics.
details.shippingReturns: Store Pickup: Available immediately at BU Student Center. Courier Delivery: Dispatched within 24 hours. Returns: 7-day return/exchange window.

reviews.author: Bea Rodriguez
reviews.comment: The cream colorway is gorgeous in person! The green vintage lettering gives it such a classic varsity feel.

reviews.author: Mark Anthony
reviews.comment: Comfortable to wear even in air-conditioned lecture halls. Definitely my favorite campus hoodie so far.

name: BUnique Ringer Tee
description: Retro BUnique Ringer Tee shirt featuring contrast collar and cuff ribbing. Soft cotton knit fabric perfect for daily campus wear.

details.material: 100% Combed Ringspun Cotton (220 GSM). Breathable, lightweight, and ultra-soft for tropical campus weather.
details.sizeFit: Regular streetwear fit. Tailored contrast rib collar and sleeves.
details.care: Machine wash cold with similar colors. Do not bleach. Air dry recommended to preserve print crispness.
details.shippingReturns: Store Pickup: Next-day claim at BU Student Center. Albay delivery: 1–2 days. 7-day exchange warranty.

reviews.author: Gabriel T.
reviews.comment: The ringer ribbing has great contrast. Breathable fabric that doesn't feel heavy under the Bicol sun.

name: BU Varsity Jacket
description: Classic BU Varsity Jacket. Premium fleece body with faux leather contrast sleeves, detailed rib-knit cuffs and hem, and classic letterman patches.

preOrderInfo.paymentPolicy: Payment is required upon placing your pre-order to reserve personalized letterman patch production.

details.material: Heavyweight Wool-Fleece body (400 GSM) with premium vegan leather sleeves, quilted diamond-stitch inner lining, and brass snap-front buttons.
details.sizeFit: Boxy collegiate varsity fit. Designed to comfortably layer over hoodies or shirts. Ribbed stand collar, cuffs, and hem.
details.care: Specialist dry clean only or spot clean sleeves with damp cloth. Do not machine wash or tumble dry.
details.shippingReturns: Store Pickup: Complimentary campus claim upon arrival notification. Courier: Insured delivery nationwide. Returns: Replacement guaranteed for sizing or craft defects within 7 days of pickup.

reviews.author: Patricia Alcantara
reviews.comment: The chenille BU patches and sleeve texture are top-notch! Feels like a genuine heirloom varsity jacket. Everyone on campus asked where I got it.

name: BUnique BU Labels Cap
description: BUnique BU Labels Cap. Adjustable 6-panel strapback design with detailed embroidery text on the front panels.

details.material: 100% Washed Cotton Twill. High-definition 3D embroidery on crown panels.
details.sizeFit: Adjustable brass buckle strapback fits circumference 54–60 cm. Pre-curved visor.
details.care: Hand wash with mild soap in cool water. Air dry in shade to maintain brim curvature.
details.shippingReturns: Store Pickup: Ready for claim in 2 hours. Courier delivery: 1-2 days Albay.

reviews.author: Rafael D.
reviews.comment: Deep forest green color is amazing. The buckle strap makes it easy to adjust.

name: BUnique Lanyard & Badge
description: BUnique Official Campus Lanyard and Pin Badge set. High density woven strap with heavy-duty metal clip.

details.material: Heavy duty jacquard woven polyester strap with zinc alloy swivel clasp and safety breakaway buckle.
details.sizeFit: Strap length 48 cm, width 2.5 cm. Comes with matching 1.25 inch zinc alloy enamel pin.
details.care: Spot clean strap with mild soapy water. Wipe pin with soft cloth.
details.shippingReturns: Store pickup available at BU Student Center. Standard courier shipping.

reviews.author: Jasmine K.
reviews.comment: Sturdy clip that doesn't bend or snap easily. Perfect for my campus student ID!

name: Insulated Water Bottle
description: Insulated Campus Water Bottle. Double-walled stainless steel keeps drinks ice-cold for 24 hours. Matte powder-coat finish.

details.material: 18/8 Food-grade stainless steel with BPA-free leakproof lid. Sweat-free powder coat exterior.
details.sizeFit: 750 mL (25 oz) capacity. Fits standard backpack side pockets and cup holders.
details.care: Hand wash recommended with bottle brush. Not suitable for microwave or freezer.
details.shippingReturns: Store pickup and courier available. 7-day replacement for vacuum seal defects.

reviews.author: Miguel O.
reviews.comment: Keeps ice intact the whole day during my long lab classes. High quality lid that doesn't leak.

name: University Pin Badge
description: Official Bicol University Metallic Pin Badge. Enamel filled with butterfly clasp backer.

details.material: Hard enamel brass alloy with gold electroplating and dual butterfly clutch pin backings.
details.sizeFit: 35 mm diameter. Ideal for lanyards, tote bags, lapels, and backpacks.
details.care: Wipe clean with a dry microfiber cloth. Store away from sharp metal keys to prevent surface scratching.
details.shippingReturns: Store pickup ready in 1 hour. Standard courier shipping available.

reviews.author: Christine L.
reviews.comment: Crisp enamel details! Pins firmly onto my canvas tote and doesn't rotate.

name: BU Polo Shirt
description: Premium Bicol University polo shirt crafted from breathable pique fabric. Features the embroidered BU logo.

details.material: Breathable Honeycomb Cotton Pique (240 GSM). Soft-touch ribbed collar and mother-of-pearl style 2-button placket.
details.sizeFit: Classic smart-casual fit. True to size; structured collar that holds shape after wash.
details.care: Machine wash warm inside out. Hang dry or light tumble. Warm iron if desired.
details.shippingReturns: Store Pickup: Claim at BU Student Center. Courier: 1-2 days Albay. 7-day replacement policy.
